title: Copy-trading backtest (H3)
question: After realistic delay and costs, does following skilled wallets make money?
headline: Copying top-tier wallets 60 min later with a 1¢ cost returns -3.8% per $1 (95% CI -16.2% to +8.1%; 1678 copies in 124 markets) vs -2.7% for other ranked wallets.
notes: Signals: top-tier trades of at least $100 with YES price in (0.05, 0.95), one per wallet/market/hour; entry at the last price after the delay plus the cost; held to resolution.
Pass rule (pre-registered): 60-minute delay, 1¢ cost, mean > 0 with CI above 0.
